_comment: User-editable budget knobs. Dungeon economics (energyCost, maxRoom, maxRunsPerDay) come from config/discovered.json (generated, gitignored) — this file only holds the numbers a human chooses. Session-08: conservative first-session budget, 3 runs at 20 energy each per session-08 brief §5. Session-09: raised to 120/5 per session-09 brief's explicit stated budget ('120 energy this session... covers five runs with margin') for Task 6's five-run stage — the guard-persistence fix landed this session made maxRunsPerSession a REAL cap across process invocations for the first time, and it was still holding at the session-08 conservative value, capping the session at 3 runs before the five-run gate could be attempted. Session-11: raised to 240/12, matching the user's own confirmed REAL daily budget (session-11 brief §6: '240 energy/day dungeon budget, 12 runs at 20 energy') rather than a session-scoped guess — the guard is date-keyed, so this is now a standing calibration to reality, not a one-day bump. Confirmed directly by the user this session (not raised unilaterally) after today's 78/5 spend from sessions 09-10 blocked the session-11 brief's ask of 3 more 20-energy runs. See DECISIONS.md.

forbiddenWoods._potionsComment: Session 24: `potions` block REMOVED — user directive: non-juiced runs must NEVER use potions. It was left at session 23's juiced-Tier-3-batch value (maxPerRun 3) after that batch never happened, and a plain orchestrator run auto-loaded 3x Big Heal Juice from it, because liveRun.ts/orchestrator.ts apply this block unconditionally to every start_run regardless of juiced status — there is no juiced-vs-plain gating in code yet (that's TASKS.md Task 14, still BLOCKED). Briefly re-added with maxPerRun:1 to resume and finish the stray room-5 run left over from that incident (its own last committed potion, user-authorized for that run only), then removed again immediately once that one `--resume-existing` invocation completed. Session 42: briefly re-added again (allowedItemId 131, maxPerRun 3) to resume and finish the user's manually-started juiced Tier-3 run (session-42 brief §0) — that run's potions were already committed at start_run before this session began, so this block only drove the mid-combat use_item threshold logic for that one `--resume-existing` invocation, not a fresh loadout. Removed again immediately once that run ended (death, room 7). Same-session follow-up: re-added a third time (allowedItemId 131, maxPerRun 3) to resume a second manually-started juiced run (this one Tier-2, silver rings) the user started mid-session; removed again once that run ended (death, room 6). Absence of this block means 0 potions loaded, full stop, on every run this bot starts — do not re-add it until Task 14 lands the juiced-only gating, at which point it should apply ONLY to genuinely-new juiced start_run calls, never plain ones.

dendren._comment: Session 13, Task 9's first live fishing budget: 100/5, conservative-first-session posture, session-13 comment retained below for history. Session 15: raised to 200/15 per the session-15 brief's direct instruction ('start live fishing casts early... the user reports 15 casts available today; raise the fishing session cap') — mineFishPatterns.ts (Task 11) needs real transition volume and the daily guard resets, so today's own allowance should actually be used rather than left idle at the old 5-cast conservative figure. 200 energy covers 16 tier-1 casts (12 energy each) with margin over the requested 15; config/discovered.json's maxCastsPerDay (10, non-juiced) is the GAME's own inferred cap and is untested past 5 casts/day — if the live loop hits a real server-side cap below 15, it fails closed (CLAUDE.md §5) rather than guessing past it. Original session-13 note: maxCastsPerSession set conservatively at 5 to match Task 9's staged gate (dry-run, one cast, then five) rather than the game's own maxCastsPerDay cap — same conservative-first-session posture as forbiddenWoods' original 3-run figure (session 08). Tier-1 casts (12 energy, the free tier — SPEC-fishing.md §3) are what the live loop uses unless told otherwise. [VERIFY] CONFIRMED [live, 2026-08-16/17]: this IS the same account-wide pool forbiddenWoods spends from. Both liveFishing.ts and liveRun.ts hit real-energy-floor guard trips (HTTP 400 on start_run) within ~10 minutes of each other, both against the SAME GET /offchain/player/energy reading (10, of 420 max, regenPerHour 18) — one pool, not two. dailyEnergyBudget above is this bot's own policy ceiling per game mode, layered on top of the one real account ceiling; hitting the real floor fails closed regardless of how much of either policy ceiling remains unspent. Session 21: raised to 240/20 — two independent sources agree on this number. `config/discovered.json`'s `dendren.maxCastsPerDayJuiced` was probe-captured back in session 11 (20 casts/day juiced, vs 10 non-juiced) but never wired into policy; the user independently confirmed this session that the real daily cast limit is 20 at 12 energy each (240 total). Not a fresh guess — the probe data and the user's own figure land on the same number.
